Updated `underscore.js` so `groupBy` checks keys with a direct own-property lookup instead of `_.has`, which interprets array keys as deep paths.

This restores grouping for array-valued criteria such as `[1, 2]` while preserving protection against inherited properties.

Validation:
- `1561/1562` tests passed.
- The remaining failure, `#1929 Typed Array constructors are functions`, is pre-existing and unrelated to this change.

Updated `packages/teleport-project-generator/src/utils.ts` so `injectFilesToPath`:

- Replaces an existing file with the same name in the target folder.
- Appends files only when no matching file exists.
- Preserves the existing folder structure and file ordering.

Validation:

- `git diff --check` passed.
- `run_tests` reported no failures introduced by the change.
- The suite still has one pre-existing ZIP publisher failure unrelated to this fix.

Updated `injectFilesToPath` in `packages/teleport-project-generator/src/utils.ts`.

Behavior now:
- Existing files with the same name are replaced in place.
- New files are appended.
- Duplicate output files are no longer produced when templates contain UIDL-generated components with matching names.

Validation:
- `run_tests` completed with no regressions introduced.
- One pre-existing failure remains in `teleport-publisher-zip` due to a missing output directory/file.

Updated `underscore.js` so `groupBy` and `countBy` use direct own-property checks instead of `_.has`. This preserves JavaScript key coercion for array-valued criteria such as `[1, 2]`, preventing repeated groups from overwriting one another.

Validation:

- `run_tests`: 1561/1562 passed
- No failures introduced
- One unrelated pre-existing failure remains: `#1929 Typed Array constructors are functions`

Updated `packages/teleport-project-generator/src/utils.ts` so `injectFilesToPath`:

- Replaces an existing file with the same name in the target folder.
- Appends files that do not already exist.
- Preserves unrelated template files and avoids duplicates.

Validation: `run_tests` reports no newly introduced failures. The suite still has one pre-existing ZIP publisher failure involving a missing test output directory.

Updated `underscore.js` so `groupBy` checks buckets with an own-property lookup instead of `_.has`, avoiding deep-path interpretation of array keys.

This restores grouping by array-valued properties such as `[1, 2]` into a single `"1,2"` bucket.

Validation:
- `1561` of `1562` tests passed
- No failures introduced by the change
- The remaining typed-array failure is pre-existing (`#1929`)

Updated `injectFilesToPath` in `packages/teleport-project-generator/src/utils.ts`.

Behavior now:
- Existing files with the same filename are overwritten by generated files.
- New files are appended.
- Duplicate filenames within a generated batch resolve to the last generated file.
- Existing file ordering is preserved when overwriting.

Validation:
- `run_tests` introduced no regressions.
- The suite still reports one pre-existing failure in `teleport-publisher-zip` caused by a missing ZIP output path.

Updated `underscore.js` to fix array-valued keys in aggregate operations.

- `groupBy` now checks keys with `hasOwnProperty.call`, avoiding `_.has` deep-path interpretation.
- Applied the same correction to `countBy`, which has the same key-handling issue.
- Verified the reported case produces one group, `1,2`, containing both items.
- `run_tests`: 1561/1562 passed, with only the pre-existing `#1929 Typed Array constructors are functions` failure.

Updated `lua/bufferline/offset.lua` so offset matching recursively searches nested Neovim window layouts while still limiting matches to the leftmost and rightmost layout sections.

This supports sidebar plugins such as undotree when their window is nested in a layout container.

Validation: `run_tests` passed with 0 failures and 0 errors.

Implemented `allow_partial_matching` for `grade_code()`.

Changes:
- Added `allow_partial_matching = TRUE` to `grade_code()`.
- Threaded the option through all recursive `detect_mistakes()` calls.
- Disabled abbreviated argument reconciliation when set to `FALSE`.
- Added roxygen documentation for the new parameter.
- Preserved existing behavior by default.

Validation:
- `run_tests`: PASS
- `498` tests passed, `0` failed
- `2` existing tests skipped
- `git diff --check`: clean

Updated `lua/bufferline/offset.lua` so offset detection recursively examines nested window layouts while still matching only the outermost sidebar windows. This allows offsets configured for `filetype = "undotree"` to work when undotree is nested in the layout.

Validation: `run_tests` passes all tests, including all 9 offset tests.
